Validation_Type.reason: Confirmed. V1 is leave-one-out cross-validation in a small sample. The paper runs a single in-sample ROC analysis of plasma p-tau181 for AD-pathology carriers vs non-carriers, pooling SCD and MCI patients and excluding AD dementia. It picks the Youden-optimal cut-off (2.69 pg/mL) and reports AUC 0.910, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, PPV and NPV on the same patients (p.3 methods, p.4 results). A search of the full text finds no leave-one-out, k-fold, bootstrap, train/test split or external cohort. Small n alone does not make a study V1. Under 'Absence of reporting = V2', unvalidated same-sample evaluation is V2.
Validation_Type.quote: Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses were performed to evaluate the ability of plasma p-tau181 to distinguish between AP+ and AP- patients. The Youden's method was used to detect the best cut-off value and accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value and negative predictive value for plasma p-tau181.
